description: Delegate multiple atomic tasks to Antigravity for batch processing. Ideal for repetitive operations, mass refactoring, and automated transformations.

concurrency.description: Maximum parallel agy processes when parallel=true. Default: min(task count, 4)

effort.description: Reasoning effort (--effort). Supported levels depend on the model — see list-models. Use with a base model ID (e.g. gemini-4-hydrogen); not supported by Orchestrator.

mode.description: Agent mode (--mode): accept-edits, auto (sandboxed autonomy; not available on every account), or plan (answers go into a plan artifact).

model.description: Optional model override applied to every task. Known: Gemini 4 Hydrogen (Low), Gemini 4 Hydrogen (Medium), Gemini 4 Hydrogen (High), Gemini 4 Hydrogen (XHigh), Gemini 4 Argon (Low), Gemini 4 Argon (Medium), Gemini 4 Argon (High), Gemini 4 Carbon (Low), Gemini 4 Carbon (Medium), Gemini 4 Carbon (High), Orchestrator (Argon), Orchestrator (Carbon), Gemini 3.8 Flash (Low), Gemini 3.8 Flash (Medium), Gemini 3.8 Flash (High), Claude Opus 5.5 (Low), Claude Opus 5.5 (Medium), Claude Opus 5.5 (High), Claude Sonnet 5.5 (Low), Claude Sonnet 5.5 (Medium), Claude Sonnet 5.5 (High), GPT-OSS 120B (Medium).

skipPermissions.description: --dangerously-skip-permissions. Default: true (print mode can't answer prompts), false when `mode` is set. Not allowed with mode plan.

stopOnError.description: Stop execution if any task fails

tasks.description: Array of atomic tasks to delegate to Antigravity

timeout.description: Maximum execution time per task in milliseconds

name: batch-antigravity
